description: Oil and Gas' Defect Object Structure
title: INCIDENT

affecteddate.title: Affected Date
affecteddate.remarks: Date when user was affected by incident. Enter a date or click the Select Date button and select a date.

plusgrelatetolocal.title: Related to Local Issue
plusgrelatetolocal.remarks: Flag used to determine if a ticket is related to a local issue ticket.

plusgisreviewreqd.title: From Review Required
plusgisreviewreqd.remarks: Specifies whether the incident record was created from a work order that requires review. If the check box is selected, the Review Required check box is selected in the Work Order Tracking application.

externalrecid.title: External Record
externalrecid.remarks: Ticket ID for any Ticket external to MAXIMO

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: Owner Group of the incident record. This group has overall responsibility for the incident. Use the Select Action menu to assign an owner group. You can enter a value either in this field or the Owner field.

plusgdefectsource.title: Defect Source
plusgdefectsource.remarks: The origin of the defect. Valid values are in the PLUSGDEFECTSOURCE domain.

calcshift.title: Shift
calcshift.remarks: Along with the calculation calendar, sets the business hours that calculate the Target Contact, Target Response, and Target Resolution dates on a ticket or work order. Click the Select Value button to choose a shift.

plusgrcfaapp.title: Approved
plusgrcfaapp.remarks: Indicates the root cause failure analysis has been approved.

plusgwhathapp.title: What should have happened?
plusgwhathapp.remarks: Enter here what should have happened in the incident being reviewed.

plusgfmecaappdate.title: Approval Date
plusgfmecaappdate.remarks: The date that the FMECA was approved.

plusgsafetyfailcat.title: Safety Failure Category
plusgsafetyfailcat.remarks: The category of the failure that is related to safety.

plusgrcaappbyname.title: Name
plusgrcaappbyname.remarks: The name of the RCA approver.

reportedpriority.title: Reported Priority
reportedpriority.remarks: Priority of incident as determined by person reporting the incident.

pluscalevel.title: Level
pluscalevel.remarks: Level; used for Apply Level select action

impact.title: Impact
impact.remarks: The Business Impact/severity of the Ticket

plusganalysiscomp.title: Analysis Completed
plusganalysiscomp.remarks: Specifies whether analysis of high context data is complete. If the check box is selected, the analysis is complete. The default value is False (check box is empty).

plusgactionsumm.title: Review Action Summary
plusgactionsumm.remarks: A summary of the review actions that are associated with the investigation.

plusgactconsqid.title: Actual Consequence Unique Id
plusgactconsqid.remarks: The actual consequence of the hazard that is associated with this incident. Valid values are in the PLUSGCONSQ synonym domain.

plusgmiremarks.title: Maintainable Item/Part Remarks
plusgmiremarks.remarks: The description of the maintainable item or part.

plusgisinvestig.title: Is Investigation
plusgisinvestig.remarks: Specifies whether the event is an investigation, rather than a problem. If the check box is selected (default), the event is an investigation.

commodity.title: Service
commodity.remarks: Service provided or purchased. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value.

plusgconsqnum.title: Consequence
plusgconsqnum.remarks: Associates the detected failure with a Consequence record. You can use this field to track the consequences of a failure.

inheritstatus.title: Inherit Status Changes
inheritstatus.remarks: Inherit status from follow up record

plusgnonconcat.title: Non-conformance Category
plusgnonconcat.remarks: The category of non-conformance with standards.

targetcontactdate.title: Target Contact
targetcontactdate.remarks: Target contact date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button.

assignedownergroup.title: Assigned Owner Group
assignedownergroup.remarks: Assigned Owner Group of the ticket record. This group has overall responsibility for the solution. Use the Select Action menu to assign an owner group. You can enter a value either in this field or the Owner field.

plusgwhydiff.title: Why were there differences?
plusgwhydiff.remarks: Enter here why there were differences between what should have happened and what actually happened in the incident being reviewed.

plusgaarrefno.title: AAR Reference Number
plusgaarrefno.remarks: The reference number for the after action review, if different from the problem identifier.

origrecorgid.title: Originating Record Oganization
origrecorgid.remarks: Organization Identifier of the originating Record

plusgisdefect.title: Is Defect
plusgisdefect.remarks: Indicates whether the incident is a defect.

vendor.title: Vendor
vendor.remarks: Identifies the vendor for the service, service group, or asset. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value.

plusgregulationnum.title: Regulation
plusgregulationnum.remarks: The regulation that is associated with the ticket. You can change this value only when the status of the ticket record is Draft. The status of the regulation must be Active.

plusoutagecode.title: Outage Code
plusoutagecode.remarks: Identifies the specific outage or outage type.

hassafetyhazard.title: Mark as Safety Hazard
hassafetyhazard.remarks: Select this option for a critical safety incident that requires immediate action.

plusgaddressdesc.title: Address Description
plusgaddressdesc.remarks: A description of the location where the incident occurred.

plusgreportedtoemail.title: E-mail
plusgreportedtoemail.remarks: The e-mail address of the person to whom the incident was reported.

ticketid.title: Incident
ticketid.remarks: Identifies the incident record. This value must be unique for all incident records.

plusgpotenconsq.title: Potential Consequence
plusgpotenconsq.remarks: The potential consequence of the hazard that is associated with this incident. Valid values are in the PLUSGCONSQ synonym domain.

plusgfrommobile.title: From Mobile
plusgfrommobile.remarks: Indicates whether the incident was created from a mobile device.

pluslnuprevnum.title: Revision
pluslnuprevnum.remarks: The revision level of the lineup

plusgfailmechrem.title: Failure Mechanism Remarks
plusgfailmechrem.remarks: The description of the failure mechanism.

plusgfailsubdiv.title: Failure Mechanism Subdivision Code
plusgfailsubdiv.remarks: The ISO 14224 subdivision code of the failure mechanism.

plusghfappby.title: Approved By
plusghfappby.remarks: The person who approved the human factors analysis. The person record for the approver must be active. Additionally, the  person must be authorized to approve a human factors analysis. Use the People application to grant approval authorization.

plusgprosafttier.title: Process Safety Tier
plusgprosafttier.remarks: The level of process safety and its associated consequences, that result from the incident. Valid values are in the PLUSGPROSAFTTIER.

plusisca.title: Corrective Action
plusisca.remarks: Indicates that the reported condition is designated for corrective action.

hassolution.title: Has Solution
hassolution.remarks: Indicates whether this ticket has a solution or not. This can be either an adhoc one or a referenced solution.

plusghfapp.title: Approved
plusghfapp.remarks: Indicates whether the human factors analysis is approved.

hasld.title: Has Long Description
hasld.remarks: Boolean flag to indicate if there is any long description for this record

plusoperabilityinput.title: Operability Input Required
plusoperabilityinput.remarks: Identify if operability input is required

plusghazardid.title: Hazard
plusghazardid.remarks: The hazard that is associated with this incident.

plusgfmecaappbyname.title: Name
plusgfmecaappbyname.remarks: The name of the FMECA approver.

plusactionreqd.title: Additional Action Reqd
plusactionreqd.remarks: Identify if additional action is required.

plusgfmecatargdate.title: Target Completion Date
plusgfmecatargdate.remarks: The target completion date for the FMECA.

plusopsshiftreview.title: Ops Shift Review Required
plusopsshiftreview.remarks: Identifies if operation shift review is required

plusginctype.title: Incident Category
plusginctype.remarks: The category of the incident that is being reported, such as Major, Minor, or Near Miss. Valid values are in the PLUSGINCIDENTTYPE domain.

globalticketid.title: Related to Global ID
globalticketid.remarks: Identifies the global ticket to which this incident is related. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value.

internalpriority.title: Internal Priority
internalpriority.remarks: Priority of the incident as determined by the service desk agent.

plusghfapprovaldate.title: Approval
plusghfapprovaldate.remarks: The date when the human factors analysis was approved.

source.title: Source
source.remarks: Source of Ticket Generation like email

plusginitdate.title: Initiating Date
plusginitdate.remarks: Date when the initiating event for the after action review occurred.

plusgpotenconsqid.title: Potential Consequence Unique Id
plusgpotenconsqid.remarks: The potential consequence of the hazard that is associated with this incident. Valid values are in the PLUSGCONSQ synonym domain.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: Unique identifier of the site. Enter a value or click the Select Value button.

isknownerror.title: Is Known Error
isknownerror.remarks: Specifies whether this is a known error. If the check box is selected, this is a known error. If the check box is cleared, this is not a known error.

plusgrootcauseiden.title: Root Cause Identified
plusgrootcauseiden.remarks: Check if a root cause has been identified.

plusgrcfaactldate.title: Actual Completion Date
plusgrcfaactldate.remarks: The actual completion date of the root cause failure analysis (RCFA).

plusgrcareqby.title: Required By
plusgrcareqby.remarks: The source of the requirement for the human factors analysis. Valid values are in the PLUSGHFREQBY domain.

plusgreltoregional.title: Related to Regional Issue
plusgreltoregional.remarks: Flag used to determine if a ticket is related to a regional issue ticket.

targetdesc.title: Target Description
targetdesc.remarks: Temporary target description for targeting CIs

plusghfreqby.title: Required By
plusghfreqby.remarks: The source of the requirement for the human factors analysis. Valid values are in the PLUSGHFREQBY domain.

plusgorigrecevtid.title: Event
plusgorigrecevtid.remarks: The incident event id that is related to this ticket. The ticket has a follow-up record relationship to the originating incident event.

plusgfmecaappby.title: Approved By
plusgfmecaappby.remarks: Identifies the person who is responsible for approving the FMECA.

plusgsafetycritelm.title: Safety Critical Element
plusgsafetycritelm.remarks: A reference to any element that is critical to safety and that is associated with a regulation. A performance standard that regulates the emission of hazardous substances can be a type of reference that applies to elements that are critical to safety.

plusgactiontakencomment.title: Action Details
plusgactiontakencomment.remarks: A description of the action that was taken after the incident occurred. To type or view additional information, click Long Description.

plusgrcaappdate.title: Approval Date
plusgrcaappdate.remarks: The date that the RCA was approved.

plusgglobalincident.title: Worldwide Incident
plusgglobalincident.remarks: Specifies whether the incident affects users at all sites and organizations. If this check box is selected, the incident is a worldwide issue.

plusgfailmech.title: Failure Mechanism Code
plusgfailmech.remarks: The ISO 14224 code of the failure mechanism.

plusgsuggestclass.title: Suggested Classification
plusgsuggestclass.remarks: Use this field to propose an alternative existing classification for the incident.

selfservsolaccess.title: Self-Service Access
selfservsolaccess.remarks: Specifies whether the solution applied to this ticket is visible to the self-service user who opened the associated self-service Service Request. If the check box is selected, the self-service user can view this record. If the check box is cleared the solution record is not visible to the self-service user.

plusgmicode.title: Maintainable Item/Part Code
plusgmicode.remarks: The identifier of the maintainable item or part that has failed.

origrecsiteid.title: Originating Record Site
origrecsiteid.remarks: Site Identifier of the originating Record

plusgdefectelim.title: Defect Eliminated
plusgdefectelim.remarks: Indicates that the defect has been eliminated.

description.title: Summary
description.remarks: Describes the incident. To enter or view additional information, click the Long Description button. Additonal text that you enter appears in the Details field.

plusgtotalscore.title: Total Score
plusgtotalscore.remarks: The total score that is assigned to the review actions that are associated with the investigation.

plustechspec.title: Tech Spec
plustechspec.remarks: Identify if a change for technical specification is required.

urgency.title: Urgency
urgency.remarks: A reflection of the speed in which a Ticket should be resolved

plusgincrevby.title: Incident Reviewed By
plusgincrevby.remarks: Identifies the person who reviewed the incident.

plusgclaimtype.title: Claim Type
plusgclaimtype.remarks: The types of claim that is associated with the incident.

plusgitemnum.title: Item
plusgitemnum.remarks: The item that is associated with the defect.

plusgdetectionmethod.title: Detection Method
plusgdetectionmethod.remarks: The method or activity by which a failure is discovered. The methods for discovering a failure can include casual observation during a routine check; a failure that is observed during continuous condition monitoring; or a failure that is discovered during an inspection.

plusgfailfix.title: Fail-Fix
plusgfailfix.remarks: Indicates whether the failure was found and fixed.

plusdsrevnum.title: Station Revision
plusdsrevnum.remarks: The revision level of this duty station plan

owner.title: Owner
owner.remarks: Owner of the incident record. This person has overall responsibility for the incident. Use the Select Action menu to assign an owner. You can enter a value either in this field or the Owner Group field.

calcorgid.title: Organization
calcorgid.remarks: Organization associated with the calculation calendar, and used with the Calendar and Shift fields to calculate the Target Contact, Target Response, and Target Resolution dates on a ticket or work order. Click the Detail Menu button to select an organization or go to the Organizations application to create one.

inspformrev.title: Current Form Revision
inspformrev.remarks: The revision number of inspection form for incident.

plusgsuggremedy.title: Suggested Remedy
plusgsuggremedy.remarks: Proposed remedy for the incident, if an acceptable solution is not available in the Solutions application.

plusgacceptinc.title: Accepted Incident
plusgacceptinc.remarks: Specifies whether the person who reviewed the incident agrees that the incident provides valid data for analysis and investigation. If the check box is selected, the incident provides valid data. The default value is False (check box is empty).

plusgreportedtophone.title: Phone
plusgreportedtophone.remarks: The phone number of the person to whom the incident was reported.

plusgincidentgroup.title: Incident Type
plusgincidentgroup.remarks: This field is used to group similar incidents. This field is used for reporting and assignment purposes. Valid values are in the PLUSGINCIDENTGROUP domain.

plusgsftyobstype.title: Safety Observation Type
plusgsftyobstype.remarks: The type of safety observation that is done, such as witnessing an unsafe act or recording an unsafe work condition.

plusgisregional.title: Regional Incident
plusgisregional.remarks: Specifies whether the incident affects users at a group of sites or organizations in one or more regions, but not in all regions. If this check box is selected, the incident is a regional issue.

plusgrecordable.title: Recordable
plusgrecordable.remarks: Specifies whether the incident is in a category that must recorded for regulatory purposes but does not need to be reported to a regulatory authority.

targetfinish.title: Target Finish
targetfinish.remarks: Target finish date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button.

plusgpolicynum.title: Operating Policy
plusgpolicynum.remarks: The operating policy that is not meeting the requirements of conformance to standards. The operating policy must be in Active status. When you duplicate a job plan record, the operating policy identifier is not copied to the duplicated record.

plusgextincref.title: External Incident Reference
plusgextincref.remarks: Identifies an external incident reporting system, for example, an operator log or a spreadsheet.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: Identifies the primary location on the incident record. If the incident record is for a location, enter its identifier in the Location field or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value. The Select Value dialog box, by default, displays all locations where the person ID in the Affected Person field is associated with a location record either as location user or as a location custodian. If the Asset Site field contains a value before you use the Select Value dialog box, the list of locations is always filtered by that value. After you select a location, Maximo copies it to the Location field. If the selected location has only a single asset associated with it, Maximo enters its identifier in the Asset field. You can enter related assets and/or locations in the Related Assets table window.

plusgdegfact.title: Degradation Factor
plusgdegfact.remarks: The factor by which the equipment has degraded.

origfromalert.title: Originates from Alert
origfromalert.remarks: Flag to indicated Monitor generated SRs

plusgfmecaactldate.title: Actual Completion Date
plusgfmecaactldate.remarks: The actual completion date for the FMECA.

plusgoperationalphasefailure.title: Operational Phase during Failure
plusgoperationalphasefailure.remarks: The type of operation that the equipment was carrying out at the time of the failure.

plusgaardate.title: AAR Date
plusgaardate.remarks: The date on which the after action review is conducted.

plusgcfwnum.title: Condition for Work
plusgcfwnum.remarks: Identifier of the condition for work (CFW) record. The status of the CFW record must be Active. This field is read-only when the status of the ticket record is Closed.

plusgccf.title: Common Cause Failure
plusgccf.remarks: When selected, indicates that the failure has a common cause.

plusghazarduid.title: Hazard
plusghazarduid.remarks: The hazard that is associated with this incident.

plusgdefectref.title: Defect Reference
plusgdefectref.remarks: Identifies an external incident reporting system, for example, an operator log or a spreadsheet.

plusgislesslearned.title: Lessons Learned
plusgislesslearned.remarks: If this check box is selected, the after action review resulted in lessons learned.

plusopsshiftreviewid.title: Operations Reviewer
plusopsshiftreviewid.remarks: User ID of the Operations Reviewer

plusgbarrierfaildetect.title: Barrier Failure Detection Method
plusgbarrierfaildetect.remarks: The method or activity by which a barrier failure is discovered.

sitevisit.title: Site Visit Required
sitevisit.remarks: Falg used to indicate of a Ticket requires an on-site visit for investigation

plusgaarfacil.title: AAR Facilitator
plusgaarfacil.remarks: The person facilitating the after action review.

plusgwhatactual.title: What actually happened?
plusgwhatactual.remarks: Enter here what actually happened in the incident being reviewed.

plusgactconsqsevr.title: Actual Severity
plusgactconsqsevr.remarks: The actual severity of the hazard that is associated with this incident.

actualcontactdate.title: Actual Contact
actualcontactdate.remarks: Actual contact date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button and select a date.

plusgcfwid.title: Condition for Work
plusgcfwid.remarks: The unique identifier of the condition for work.

plusgapprovaldate.title: Approval Date
plusgapprovaldate.remarks: The approval date of the root cause failure analysis.

plusgrcfalead.title: RCFA Lead
plusgrcfalead.remarks: The person leading the root cause failure analysis (RCFA).

plusgknowarea.title: Knowledge Area
plusgknowarea.remarks: Identifies the area of knowledge capture relevant to the investigation.

plusdsunit.title: Unit
plusdsunit.remarks: The Unit(s) which this Duty Station applies to

plusgincimpact.title: Incident Impact
plusgincimpact.remarks: Impact of the incident, for example, Health or Reputation. Valid values are in the PLUSGINCIMPACT domain.

plusgreportedto.title: ReportedTo
plusgreportedto.remarks: Identifies the person reporting the issue on the ticket.

plusgislocal.title: Local Incident
plusgislocal.remarks: Specifies whether the incident affects users at one site or group of sites, but not at all sites and organizations. If this check box is selected, the incident is a local issue.

plusgfmecaleadname.title: Name
plusgfmecaleadname.remarks: The name of the FMECA lead.

plusginvesttype.title: Investigation Type
plusginvesttype.remarks: The type of Investigation. Valid values are in the PLUSGINVESTIGATION domain.

plusghardfailmode.title: Hardware Failure Mode
plusghardfailmode.remarks: The hardware failure mode according to International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) standard 61508.

plusgreportable.title: Reportable
plusgreportable.remarks: Specifies whether the incident is in a category that must be reported to the United States Department of Labor (OSHA) or another regulatory agency.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: Status of the incident record. If you are not viewing the Change Status dialog box, click the Change Status button in the toolbar to change the status. Default statuses are NEW, QUEUED, PENDING, INPROG, RESOLVED, and CLOSED. See the Incidents Help for more information on statuses.

plusclrevnum.title: Revision
plusclrevnum.remarks: The revision level of the clearance

plusgsubcode.title: Subunit/Component Code
plusgsubcode.remarks: The identifier of the subunit or the component that failed.

plusgrcaappby.title: Approved By
plusgrcaappby.remarks: Identifies the person who is responsible for approvingthe RCA.

plusgfailimpactonfunction.title: Impact of Failure on Function
plusgfailimpactonfunction.remarks: The impact of the failure on the functioning of the equipment.

plusgrcaactldate.title: Actual Completion Date
plusgrcaactldate.remarks: The actualcompletion date for the RCA.

plusgrcaleadname.title: Name
plusgrcaleadname.remarks: The name of the RCA lead.

commoditygroup.title: Service Group
commoditygroup.remarks: Identifies the group providing the service. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value.

plusgfunctn.title: Function
plusgfunctn.remarks: The function that is responsible for the reason for work that is associated with the ticket. Valid values are in the PLUSGFUNCTION domain. This field is read-only.

plusgrfwnum.title: Reason for Work
plusgrfwnum.remarks: Identifier of the reason for work (RFW) record. The status of the RFW record must be Active. This field is read-only when the status of the ticket record is Closed.

plusgsubremarks.title: Subunit/Component Remarks
plusgsubremarks.remarks: The description of the subunit or the component that failed.

plusgnoncondetail.title: Non-conformance Details
plusgnoncondetail.remarks: The description of the non-conformance with standards or regulations.

plusginccontext.title: Context of Incident
plusginccontext.remarks: Information about the nature of the incident.

reportedby.title: Reported By
reportedby.remarks: Person reporting the issue for the Ticket

plusgnonconaccby.title: Accepted By
plusgnonconaccby.remarks: The person who is accepting that the item or part does not meet the standards of conformance.

plusgtechauth.title: Technical Authority
plusgtechauth.remarks: The technical authority who is associated with the non-conformance.

plusgaarlead.title: AAR Lead
plusgaarlead.remarks: The person leading the after action review.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: Identifies the primary asset on the incident record. If the incident record is for an asset, enter its identifier in the Asset field or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value. The Select Value dialog box, by default, displays all assets where the person ID in the Affected Person field is associated with an asset as either an asset user or an asset custodian. If the Asset Site field contains a value before you use the Select Value dialog box, the list of assets is always filtered by that value. After you select an asset, Maximo copies the asset location to the Location field. You can enter related assets and/or locations in the Related Assets table window.

plusgrcaisapp.title: Approved
plusgrcaisapp.remarks: Indicates whether the RCA is approved.

plusghfactldate.title: Actual Completion
plusghfactldate.remarks: The actual completion date of the human factors analysis.

assetsiteid.title: Asset Site
assetsiteid.remarks: Site of the asset on the incident record. The default value is the site of the person record in the Affected User field. Enter a value or click the Select Value button. If the Asset Site field contains a value before you access the Select Value dialog box on the Asset or Location field, the list of assets or locations is always filtered by this value. You cannot edit this field after you have associated assets or locations with a record; you must remove the associations before you can edit this field.

plusgactconsq.title: Actual Consequence
plusgactconsq.remarks: The actual consequence of the hazard that is associated with this incident. Valid values are in the PLUSGCONSQ synonym domain.

plusgpotenconsqsevr.title: Potential Severity
plusgpotenconsqsevr.remarks: The potential severity of the hazard that is associated with this incident.

plusgriskassessid.title: Risk Assessment Unique Identifier
plusgriskassessid.remarks: The unique identifier of the risk assessment.

actualfinish.title: Actual Finish
actualfinish.remarks: Actual finish date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button and select a date.

hasactivity.title: Has Activity
hasactivity.remarks: Does this ticket has any activity

plusgfmecalead.title: FMECA Lead
plusgfmecalead.remarks: Identifies the person who is responsible for performing the FMECA.

plusgbehavconseq.title: Consequences of Observed Behavior
plusgbehavconseq.remarks: Consequences of the behavior that you or others observed during the incident.

plusghighcontext.title: High Context
plusghighcontext.remarks: Specifies whether the incident is a high-context incident. If the check box is selected, the incident is high-context. The default is False (check box is empty).

plusgnewclass.title: New Classification
plusgnewclass.remarks: Proposed new classification for the incident.

pluscondtag.title: Condition Tag
pluscondtag.remarks: Tag placed in the field to identify a condition, deficiency, or work

plusgrcfaanystype.title: Analysis Type
plusgrcfaanystype.remarks: The type of analysis method that was used for the root cause failure analysis (RCFA). Valid values are in the PLUSGRCFATYPE domain.

pluslnuptype.title: Type
pluslnuptype.remarks: Segregates the lineups which are the plans from the lineups which are executed

origrecordid.title: Originating Record
origrecordid.remarks: Identifies the ticket or work order that created this incident record. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value.

plusgmigrationreq.title: Mitigation Required
plusgmigrationreq.remarks: Indicates whether the failure requires mitigating action to maintain overall system integrity.

solution.title: Solution
solution.remarks: Identifies the solution. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value. Maximo copies information to the Symptom, Cause, and/or Resolution fields, but you can edit it.

plusgshftlogentryid.title: Shift Log Entry
plusgshftlogentryid.remarks: The shift log entry that is related to this ticket. The ticket has a follow-up record relationship to the originating shift log entry.

actualstart.title: Actual Start
actualstart.remarks: Actual start date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button and select a date.

affectedphone.title: Phone
affectedphone.remarks: Telephone number of person affected by the incident.

plusgrfwid.title: Reason for Work
plusgrfwid.remarks: The unique identifier of the reason for work.

plusgfmecaisapp.title: Approved
plusgfmecaisapp.remarks: Indicates whether the FMECA is approved.

plusghassafetycrit.title: Safety Critical Element Failure
plusghassafetycrit.remarks: Indicates that a safety critical element has failed.

plusgmanrca.title: Mandatory
plusgmanrca.remarks: Specifies whether the initiating event requires a structured root cause analysis to determine the root cause of the incident.

plusgrcfatargdate.title: Target Completion Date
plusgrcfatargdate.remarks: The target completion date of the root cause failure analysis (RCFA).

targetstart.title: Target Start
targetstart.remarks: Target start date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button.

plusgworktype.title: Work Type
plusgworktype.remarks: The type of service request, for example, preventive maintenance or capital project. Valid values are in the PLUSGWORKTYPE domain. This field is read-only when the status of the service request record is Closed.

plusgmanhf.title: Mandatory
plusgmanhf.remarks: Specifies whether the initiating event requires a human factors analysis to determine the root cause of the incident.

createwomulti.title: Create WO Options
createwomulti.remarks: Identifies what happens to Multi table entries on Tickets when follow-up Work Orders are created

plusgmanrcfa.title: Mandatory
plusgmanrcfa.remarks: Specifies whether the initiating event requires a mandatory root cause failure analysis (RCFA). If the check box is selected, an RCFA is required.

pluspercentpower.title: Percent Power
pluspercentpower.remarks: Reactor power level at the time of Operations Shift Review

reportedemail.title: E-mail
reportedemail.remarks: E-mail address of person reporting the incident.

plusgrcfaappby.title: Approved By
plusgrcfaappby.remarks: The person who approved the root cause failure analysis. The status of this person must be Active, and this person must have approval authorization.

plusgactiontaken.title: Action Taken
plusgactiontaken.remarks: The action that is associated with the incident. Valid values are in the PLUSGACTIONTAKEN domain.

plusopsshiftupdated.title: Operation Shift Updated
plusopsshiftupdated.remarks: It says if operational shift review has been performed on the condition report

calccalendar.title: Calendar
calccalendar.remarks: Business days and times used to calculate the Target Contact, Target Response, and Target Resolution dates on a ticket or work order. Click the Detail Menu to select a calendar or go to the Calendars application to create one.

plusghflead.title: Human Factors Lead
plusghflead.remarks: The name of the person who is leading the human factors analysis.

reportdate.title: Reported Date
reportdate.remarks: Date when the incident was reported. Enter a date or click the Select Date button.

plusgrcfareqby.title: Required By
plusgrcfareqby.remarks: The source of the requirement for the root cause failure analysis (RCFA). Valid values are in the PLUSGRCFAREQBY domain.

plusgshiftlogid.title: Shift Log
plusgshiftlogid.remarks: The unique identifier of shift log.

reportedphone.title: Phone
reportedphone.remarks: Telephone number of person reporting the incident.

plusgrcatargdate.title: Target Completion Date
plusgrcatargdate.remarks: The target completion date for the RCA.

plusgnonconaccept.title: Non-conformance Accepted
plusgnonconaccept.remarks: When selected, indicates that a part or an item does not meet the requirements of regulations or standards.

plusgstrategic.title: Strategic
plusgstrategic.remarks: Identifies that the incident is in a strategically important area for knowledge capture.

plusghftargdate.title: Target Completion
plusghftargdate.remarks: The target completion date of the human factors analysis.

plusreportabilityreview.title: Reportability Review Required
plusreportabilityreview.remarks: Identify if reportability review is required.

plusgclaimref.title: Claim Reference
plusgclaimref.remarks: Reference information for the claim that is associated with the incident.

plusgrcalead.title: RCA Lead
plusgrcalead.remarks: Identifies the person who is responsible for performing the FMECA.

affectedemail.title: E-mail

plusgopenomuid.title: Open Unique Idenfitier
plusgopenomuid.remarks: The open unique identifier provided to Maximo by an external system.

plusgbehavobserv.title: Behavior Observed
plusgbehavobserv.remarks: Behavior that you or others observed during the incident.

relatedtoglobal.title: Related to Global Issue
relatedtoglobal.remarks: Flag used to determine if a Ticket is related to a global issue Ticket

plusgfailsubdivrem.title: Failure Mechanism Subdivision Remarks
plusgfailsubdivrem.remarks: The description of the failure mechanism subdivision.

failurecode.title: Failure Class
failurecode.remarks: Indicates Top level of a Failure Hierarchy

plusginvestreqd.title: Investigation Required
plusginvestreqd.remarks: Specifies whether the incident requires an investigation. If the check box is selected, the incident requires an investigation. The default value is False (check box is empty).

plusgopercondatfailure.title: Operating Condition during Failure
plusgopercondatfailure.remarks: The state of the equipment at the time of the failure.

inspformnum.title: Inspection Form
inspformnum.remarks: The identifier of the inspection form for incident.

isglobal.title: Global Issue
isglobal.remarks: Specifies whether the ticket is global. A global ticket either affects many users or is a root cause of other tickets. If the check box is selected, the ticket is global. You can view or specify its class in the Global Class field. You can use a global ticket to manage groups of related tickets. When you change the status of the global record, the status of all globally- related records changes. If your administrator defines automated notifications of status changes, all initial requesters who reported the same issue are notified of the status changes.
